name: Integrated Proteins Limited
summary: Integrated Proteins Limited operates in the oilseed processing sector, specializing in materials such as soybeans, mustard, rapeseed, and groundnut. The company's extensive operations cover the entire value chain, from the sourcing and crushing of diverse raw materials to the manufacturing, refining, and global distribution of its products. It produces a broad spectrum of edible, non-edible, deodorized, and refined vegetable oils, as well as various oil cakes. These are extracted from a wide array of oilseeds, including soybeans, groundnuts, cotton seeds, rapeseeds, sunflower seeds, and other oil-bearing nuts, cakes, and cereals, utilizing crushing methods that may or may not involve chemical additives. Established on October 14, 1992, Integrated Proteins Limited is headquartered in Jamnagar, India.
